title: 지하철역에서 길 묻기: 2호선 타는 곳이 어디예요?
objective: Ask where to catch a train and check with -죠? (-지요?).
summary: Ask station staff where to catch a train and check with -죠/-지요.
setting: Leo is inside a subway station with a big bag. He wants to take Line 2 to Hongik University Station, so he asks a station staff member for help.

task.title: Read, choose and ask
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to answer each question, then check your answers at the bottom of the page.

words.meaning: …, right? (checks something you think is true; after a noun use (이)죠: 이쪽이죠?)
words.exampleMeaning: The next stop is City Hall, right?

words.meaning: the place where you get on (a train or bus)
words.example: 버스 타는 곳은 역 앞에 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The bus stop is in front of the station.

words.meaning: to go down (to a lower floor)

words.exampleMeaning: If you follow the signs, you'll come to the exit.
Cross over to the other side.

dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, where do I get on Line 2?
Line 2? Go down the stairs over there.
I go down the stairs and keep going straight, right?

dialogue.korean: 네, 쭉 가다가 왼쪽으로 가세요. 초록색 표지판이 보일 거예요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, go straight and then turn left. You'll see a green sign.
But I have a lot of bags. There's an elevator too, isn't there?

dialogue.korean: 네, 있어요. 화장실 옆에 엘리베이터가 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, there is. The elevator is next to the restroom.
I'm going to Hongik University Station. I can get on from this side, right?

dialogue.korean: 아니요, 반대쪽에서 타세요. 타기 전에 표지판을 꼭 확인하세요.
dialogue.meaning: No, get on from the opposite side. Be sure to check the sign before you get on.

exercises: Read the dialogue and answer in Korean: ① 엘리베이터는 어디에 있어요? ② 레오는 어디에서 지하철을 타야 해요?
Choose the right word: ① 이 길로 (쭉 / 꼭) 가면 돼요. ② 지하 2층으로 (내려가세요 / 확인하세요). ③ 3호선 (타는 곳 / 확인하세요)이 어디예요?
Change each sentence into a question with -죠? to check: ① 엘리베이터는 저쪽이에요. ② 여기에서 4호선을 타요.
Choose the best reply: A asks "이쪽에서 타면 되죠?" but the train leaves from the other side. (a) 네, 이쪽에서 타세요. (b) 아니요, 반대쪽에서 타세요.
answers: ① 화장실 옆에 있어요. ② 반대쪽에서 타야 해요.
① 쭉 ② 내려가세요 ③ 타는 곳
① 엘리베이터는 저쪽이죠? (저쪽이지요?) ② 여기에서 4호선을 타죠? (타지요?)
